title: My Son Forged My Signature, Sold His Studio, Left Me Facing Foreclosure. So I Took His Studio
description: After I co-signed a $180,000 loan for my son's recording studio using my condo as collateral, he forged a release and sold the business for $750,000. I uncovered the fraud, won a $340,000 judgment, and reclaimed all the equipment. Now I own Treble Betrayal Studio, where my son works as a janitor, his wages garnished to pay me back. #RevengeStory #ForgeryJustice #StudioComeback
thumb_text: HE FORGED MY SIGNATURE, NOW HE'S MY JANITOR
pinned_comment: If your own son forged your signature and sold his studio for $750,000, leaving you facing foreclosure, what would you do? Share your story in the comments.
